descriptions.w3d_d28g_spawner_pick_clear_spot_8004a40: Picks a spawn spot: settles a body with step 9, then repeats choosing a random x and z inside the ground bounds, sweeping down with velocity -10 for up to 1000 steps, rejecting no contact or a landing below the water height from +184, and rejecting spots whose radius probe finds an actor with flag 1; stores the accepted spot at +40.
